seed_data_creation: Created test user with premium status for testing authenticated endpoints. Created 2 test tournaments during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New features tested: 1) Tournament system with create/register/start/detail endpoints working, 2) Spectator mode with active-matches endpoint, 3) Mots Cachés word search game with 12x12 grid and 8 biblical words, 4) Labyrinthe maze game with 15x15 maze and 3 questions. Fixed duo/leaderboard and duo/stats KeyError bugs by using .get() with defaults. Socket.IO path is /api/socket.io.

bugs_fixed.issue: KeyError: 'losses' when duo_leaderboard entries don't have all fields (wins, losses, draws)
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Code accessed entry['wins'], entry['losses'], entry['draws'] directly without checking if fields exist
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed to use entry.get('wins', 0), entry.get('losses', 0), entry.get('draws', 0), entry.get('mmr', 1000)

bugs_fixed.issue: Same KeyError issue when user's leaderboard entry has incomplete data
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Same pattern - direct dictionary access without defaults
